import json
P='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0d1-u1-ceiling/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs/'
prog='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    def depth(i,j):
        best=99
        for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            x,y=i+di,j+dj; c=0; cur=g[i][j]
            while 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]!=0:
                if g[x][y]!=cur: c+=1; cur=g[x][y]
                x+=di; y+=dj
            best=min(best,c)
        return best
    depths={(i,j):depth(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]}
    seen=set(); g2=[r[:] for r in g]
    for start in list(depths):
        if start in seen: continue
        q=[start]; seen.add(start); comp=[]
        while q:
            a,b=q.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
            for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(a+di,b+dj)
                if n in depths and n not in seen:
                    seen.add(n); q.append(n)
        M=max(depths[c] for c in comp)
        colors=[None]*(M+1)
        for a,b in comp:
            d=depths[(a,b)]
            if colors[d] is None: colors[d]=g[a][b]
        for a,b in comp:
            g2[a][b]=colors[M-depths[(a,b)]]
    return g2
'''
